questions.question: If sqrt {( {2 + 7x} )} = sqrt {( {3x + 4} )} then find the value of x.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 √(2 + 7x) = √(3x + 4)

Calculation:

Squaring both sides,

⇒ 2 + 7x = 3x + 4

⇒ 7x – 3x = 4 – 2

⇒ 4x = 2

**⇒ x = 2/4 = 0.5**

questions.question: The product of two even consecutive numbers is 168. Find the sum of numbers.
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let the consecutive even numbers be ‘x’ and ‘(x + 2)’

Product of numbers = 168

⇒ x(x + 2) = 168

⇒ x² + 2x – 168 = 0

⇒ x² + 14x – 12x – 168 = 0

⇒ x(x + 14) – 12(x + 14) = 0

⇒ (x + 14)(x – 12) = 0

⇒ x = – 14, 12 (Neglecting negative values)

⇒ x + 2 = 12 + 2 = 14

**∴ Sum of the numbers = 12 + 14 = 26**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**We will solve it using unit digits.

The unit digit of the number is 168.

The unit digits of two consecutive even numbers whose product of the digits is 8 = 2 × 4

Hence, the unit digits of the unknown numbers = 2 and 4

The sum of unit digits = 2 + 4 = 6 

The unit digit of our answer must be equal to 6.

∴ The sum is 26.

questions.question: A line DE parallel to the side BC intersects the other two sides of triangle at point D and E such that AD = (1)/(6) AB and AE = (1)/(6) AC. If the value of BC is 18 cm then calculate the value of DE (in cm).
questions.solution:
Calculation:

The given triangle can be drawn as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0edd2d924d1a513074d832eb75489aea02bb59679d4d3ec69b3d0091e9bad70a.png] 

Considering similar triangles ∆ABC and ∆ADE,

∵ Their corresponding sides are in proportion,

⇒ AB/AD = BC/DE

Given, AD = (1/6)AB and BC = 18 cm

⇒ AB/(1/6)AB = 18/DE

⇒ 6 = 18/DE

**∴ DE = 18/6 = 3 cm**

questions.question: The value of a car depreciates at the rate of 15% per annum. If its present value is Rs. 433500, then what was the value (in Rs) of the car before 2 years?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Rate of Depreciation = 15%

Present value = Rs. 433500

**FORMULA USED:**

Value n years ago = P/[(1 – R/100)n]

**CALCULATION:**

If the present value of an article is Rs. P and it depreciates at a rate of R% per annum, then,

Its value n years ago = P/[(1 – R/100)ⁿ]

Given, P = Rs. 433500, R = 15%, n = 2 year

questions.question: If A : B : C = 2 : 3 : 5 and C : D = 2 : 5, then what is A : D?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 A ∶ B ∶ C = 2 ∶ 3 ∶ 5

**Calculation:**

Multiplying by 2,

⇒ A ∶ B ∶ C = 4 ∶ 6 ∶ 10

Also, C ∶ D = 2 ∶ 5

Multiplying by 5,

⇒ C ∶ D = 10 ∶ 25

**∴ A ∶ D = 4 ∶ 25**

questions.question: In a mixture of 35 litres, the ratio of water and acid is 6 : 1. If 5 litres of acid is added to the mixture, then what will be the ratio of water and acid in the new mixture?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

In a mixture of 35 litres, the ratio of water and acid is 6: 1. If 5 litres of acid is added to the mixture, the Ratio of water and acid in the initial mixture = 6 ∶ 1

**Calculation:**

Sum of ratios = 6 + 1 = 7

Quantity of acid in 35 litres of initial mixture = (1/7) × 35 = 5 litres

When 5 litres of acid is added to 35 litres of the initial mixture,

Quantity of new mixture = 35 + 5 = 40 litres

Quantity of acid in new mixture = 5 + 5 = 10 litres

Quantity of water in new mixture = 40 – 10 = 30 litres

**∴ Water-acid ratio in new mixture = 30 ∶ 10 = 3 ∶ 1**

questions.question: The average savings of Champak in 5 days is Rs. 160. If his savings for the ﬁrst 4 days is Rs. 155, Rs. 170, Rs. 134 and Rs. 168 respectively, then what is his saving (in Rs) of the 5th day?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Total savings in five days = 5 × 160 = Rs. 800

Total savings in first 4 days = 155 + 170 + 134 + 168 = Rs. 627

**∴ Saving of 5th day = 800 – 627 = Rs. 173**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 6000 is borrowed at compound interest at the rate of 8% per annum. What will be the amount (in Rs) after 2 years?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

When the interest is compounded annually on a sum of Rs. P at R% per annum, then

Amount after n years = P[(1 + R/100)ⁿ]

Hence, when P = Rs. 6000, R = 8%

**∴ Amount after 2 years = 6000 × [(1 + 8/100)²] = 6000 × 1.1664 = Rs. 6998.4**

questions.question: Cost price of an article is Rs. 122. If proﬁt percentage is 56%, then what is the selling price (in Rs) of the article?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Cost price = Rs. 122

Profit % = 56%

∵ Selling price = Cost price + Profit

**∴ Selling price of article = 122 + 56% of 122 = 122 + 68.32 = Rs. 190.32**

questions.question: On selling a watch at 4/5th of the marked price, there is a loss of 4%. What will be the ratio between the marked price and cost price of the watch?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let the Marked price be Rs. ‘x’

Selling price = (4/5)x

If there is a loss of 4%, then, Cost price – loss = Selling price

⇒ CP – 4% of CP = (4/5)x

⇒ 96% of CP = (4/5)x

⇒ (24/25) CP = (4/5)x

⇒ CP = (5/6)x

**∴ Ratio of Marked price to Cost price = x ∶ (5/6)x = 6 ∶ 5**

questions.question: What is the positive square root of [19 + 4√21]?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let √[19 + 4√21] = √x + √y

Squaring both sides, we get,

⇒ 19 + 4√21 = x + y + 2√xy

⇒ 19 + 2√(4 × 21) = x + y + 2√xy

Hence on comparing,

⇒ x + y = 19 ----(1)

⇒ xy = 21 × 4 = 84 ----(2)

Substituting (1) in (2), we get,

⇒ x(19 – x) = 84

⇒ x² – 19x + 84 = 0

⇒ x<s

questions.question: 18 men or 25 boys can complete a work in 25 days. How many days will 36 men and 10 boys will take to complete the work?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

18 men 1-day work = 1/25

1 men 1 day work = 1/(18 × 25) = 1/450

36 men 1 day work = 36 × 1/450 = 2/25

Similarly,

25 boys 1 day work = 1/25

1 boy 1 day work = 1/(25 × 25) = 1/625

10 boys 1 day work = 10 × 1/625 = 2/125

Hence,

1 day work of 36 men and 10 boys = 2/25 + 2/125 = 12/125

**∴ 36 men and 10 boys will complete the work in 125/12 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** According to the question,

18 × M = 25 × B

⇒ M/B = 25/18

Total work = 25 × 25 × 18

Total efficiency = 36 × 25 + 10 × 18

⇒ 1080

Required time = (25 × 25 × 18)/1080

**⇒ 125/12 days**

questions.question: Vipin crosses a 450 metres wide road in 9 seconds. What is his speed (in km/hr)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 450 m

Time = 9 seconds

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Speed of Vipin = Distance traveled by Vipin/Time taken 

⇒ 450/9 = 50 m/sec.

**⇒ 50 × (18/5) = 180 km/hr**

questions.question: If the lengths of the two parallel sides of a trapezium are 8 cm and 10 cm and the distance between these parallel sides is 6 cm. Find its area (in cm2).
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Area of a trapezium = [(sum of parallel sides) × (height of trapezium)]/2

Area of given trapezium = [(10 + 8) × 6]/2

= 9 × 6

= 54 cm²

**∴ Area of given trapezium is 54 cm²**

questions.question: If the diameter of a circle is 7 cm, then what will be its circumference (in cm)?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Diameter (d) of circle = 7 cm

Radius (r) = 7/2

Circumference of a circle = 2πr

Using π = 22/7

Circumference of given circle = 2 × 22/7 × 7/2

**⇒** 22 cm

**∴ The circumference of the circle is 22 cm.**

questions.question: Find the volume (in cm³) of a cube of side 6.5 cm.
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Volume of a cube = (side)³

Volume of the cube with side 6.5 cm = (6.5)³

= 274.625 cm³

**∴ Volume of the cube is 274.625 cm3**

questions.solution:

In the given ∆DEF shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2603eb483a57c5050e1bc07f5ddc29d8bec5afe8d9743498ae60190418d3aac0.png] 

sin D = opposite/hypotenuse = EF/DF = 15/17
